explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/362: for a finite A ⊆ ℕ of size N and any fixed t, are there ≪ 2^N/N^{3/2} subsets S ⊆ A with Σ_{n∈S} n = t? Yes (Sárközy–Szemerédi, removing the log factor from Erdős–Moser). The Lean statement: ∃ C, ∀ nonempty finite A ⊆ ℕ and t, #{S ⊆ A | ΣS = t} ≤ C·2^{|A|}/|A|^{3/2}. The constant is uniform in A and t, as intended; nonemptiness avoids division by zero. Faithful.
